$comment: Seed data for the demo and for tests. Deliberately shaped so the interesting cases are reachable: INV-4471 is the unattributed payment, INV-4472 shares a payer with INV-4471 so the ambiguity guard has something to fire on, and INV-4473 is the clean control case with a correct reference.
$amounts: Figures are deliberately small. KeeperHub bounds a single stablecoin outflow at 100 USD and our Sepolia org wallet holds ~19 USDC, so a 4,200 invoice with 1,200/860/2,140 supplier payouts cannot be paid on any write path — each supplier would be refused by the per-call cap before a signature was ever produced (verified live 2026-09-13: HTTP 400, 'exceeds the 100.00 USD per-transaction limit'). Scaling by 1/100 keeps the three-supplier structure, the two-party ambiguity, and the batch-payout centrepiece reachable with the funds actually available. tests/fixtures.test.ts enforces these invariants so a re-scale cannot silently break the demo again.
